title.narrative: E-services and digital infrastructure as COVID-19 response measure

description.narrative: The general objective of this action is to accelerate the digital transformation of public administration in Montenegro as COVID-19 response measure, by enabling effective digital service provision that meets the needs of citizens and businesses.The specific objectives are:SO1: Enhance digitalization of the public administration through the development of platforms and complex e-services SO2: Establish an efficient and sustainable integrated system of simplified electronic procedures for citizens and businessesSO3: Improve data protection and digital inclusion of public institutions
